answer: Seats flood when minting a new key is almost free. Each applicant posts a 150-unit bond, collects two time-locked range proofs — one at a knoll survey post, one from a network vertex operator — then finishes a sealed-packet voyage between those posts inside a 90-minute window. Peers reconstruct the time-of-flight triangle and accept only if the ranges disagree by less than 40 meters. An 8-unit courier fee is sunk. A late window or a 40-meter miss slashes 50 units and cools the pubkey for five epochs; a reused packet empties the bond and bars that key for twelve epochs.
